errors.quote: If it shifts with p53 status, it is p53-dependent and cannot be used for matching
errors.issue: A genotype-dependent marker distribution may reflect real differing lesion burden rather than an invalid measurement. Selecting a marker because it agrees at equal nominal dose is circular. Validate its lesion specificity independently, measure immediate injury, and preserve later biological repair differences.

errors.quote: daughter cells born in a prespecified pre-damage window, still alive at damage, and therefore in G1
errors.issue: Birth within a window does not guarantee G1 at damage. Calibrate that window against the fastest G1 transit or require a validated live phase measure; the later optional reporter leaves the primary cohort eligibility uncertain.

errors.quote: Cells already dead at damage, born outside the window, or lost to tracking gaps longer than one cell-cycle transition are excluded
errors.issue: The first two define baseline eligibility, but subsequent tracking loss is missing outcome data. Do not simply remove it: retain starting-cohort counts, inspect condition-related loss and specify informative-loss bounds or a justified model.

errors.quote: A higher G1 percentage with unchanged absolute G1 count and loss of S or G2 cells is composition change, not arrest.
errors.issue: This pattern can include both selective death and true prolonged G1 residence. Absolute counts help but do not uniquely exclude an arrest component; the tracked G1-to-S histories must adjudicate it.

errors.quote: Necessity, under acceptance rules, is supported only if C_nec is negative beyond the prespecified margin
errors.issue: A meaningful reduction need not abolish the defined response. Add a negligible-residual requirement or keep the narrower opening claim of contribution; restoration toward the intact state likewise needs a quantitative restoration criterion.

errors.quote: such as a degron at the endogenous locus or an inducible knockdown
errors.issue: Select one concrete acute manipulation and its resistant rescue architecture. Basal rescue level alone also does not establish matching of induced abundance/dynamics.

rationale: Good bounded opening, damage-by-genotype contrasts, explicit starting cohort and separate death/caffeine outputs. Marker validation is circular, cohort eligibility and missing-track handling are incomplete, and some composition/necessity conclusions exceed the measurements. Modestly exceeds the response limit.
reference_guardrails: All four complete final answers, the exact candidate question/packet and complete frozen reference including curator clarification were personally read. No paid judge, hidden reasoning or actual experiment was used.

The reference body retains survivor-only and damage-recalibration language. Its explicit clarification takes precedence: use starting-cohort denominators and competing death outcomes; match initial delivered injury without removing later repair differences caused by p53.

A partial loss of arrest supports contribution to the response. Full necessity for the defined response requires evidence that meaningful damage-induced arrest is absent after effective loss, with uncertainty and rescue specificity. Do not demand exact zero or universal dependence.

Common external exposure and state-specific lesion matching estimate different effects. Neither is rejected categorically if justified and reported. Merely adjusting for a post-treatment mediator is not automatically a matched-damage causal experiment.

Near-endogenous rescue includes damage-induced kinetics and cell-to-cell abundance; successful damage-dependent rescue does not prove p53-alone sufficiency. Assay/dose calibration proposals are legitimate because identities and timings were not supplied.

Predetermined outcome-based rejection can still select confirmatory results. Distinguish technical failure from biological death, lesion burden or negative arrest outcomes and preserve the latter in reporting.

Live tracking must distinguish S entry followed by death, no S entry before death, persistent viable G1, and unresolved tracking. No informative-loss mechanism is cured by labeling all loss censoring.

The source audit here is limited to indexed primary-paper abstract/metadata excerpts; PubMed/PMC full-page access was challenged. No full historical methods audit is claimed. Scoring follows the supplied hypothetical packet rather than unavailable methods.

AID-mediated depletion recognizes a protein tag: synonymous recoding does not make an otherwise identical tagged protein resistant. Untagged rescue is a valid alternative. The AID2 paper abstract, introduction and initial results through the reporter comparisons were read, not its full supplementary protocol.
GLM and Kimi fit 3500 words; Grok is approximately 3602 and Qwen 4460 whitespace-delimited words. Length affects communication only, not a substitute for scientific scoring.

Primary starting-cohort definitions receive credit where specified. Competing-risk S-entry incidence includes dependence on death; it is not an intervention eliminating death. Lists of S entry, later death and division need an event hierarchy.

Marker agreement at equal nominal exposure does not validate marker independence. Direct lesion measurement may differ because delivered damage truly differs. Early phenotype matching is not lesion matching.
Overlapping lesion distributions alone do not show equivalence. Post-treatment restriction/adjustment requires a shared observation unit and explicit causal assumptions.
